summary: Stannous fluoride is a topical dental fluoride that aids in the prevention of cavities, helps prevent gingivitis and interferes with the harmful effects of plaque, and builds protection against painful tooth sensitivity. OTC products include a 0.454% w/w dentifrice (~0.15% w/v fluoride ion) and a 0.4% gel. Applied by brushing teeth thoroughly twice daily; minimize swallowing and spit out after brushing. Systemic absorption is minimal with proper use.
indications: Aids in the prevention of dental cavities (anticaries)
Helps prevent gingivitis and helps interfere with the harmful effects of plaque associated with gingivitis (antigingivitis)
Builds increasing protection against painful sensitivity of the teeth to cold, heat, acids, sweets or contact (antihypersensitivity)

dosage.d: Apply at least a 1-inch strip of 0.454% dentifrice to a soft toothbrush; brush all teeth thoroughly >=1 minute
dosage.t: Twice daily (morning and evening); not more than 3x/day
dosage.n: Minimize swallowing; spit out after brushing

dosage.d: Apply 0.4% stannous fluoride gel and brush onto teeth as directed
dosage.t: Once or twice daily per directions
dosage.n: Do not swallow; spit out after use

dosage.d: Consult a dentist or doctor before use
dosage.n: Keep out of reach of children under 12

admin: Apply at least a 1-inch strip of dentifrice onto a soft-bristle toothbrush
Brush teeth thoroughly for at least 1 minute, twice a day (morning and evening), and not more than 3 times a day
Make sure to brush all sensitive areas of the teeth
Minimize swallowing and spit out after brushing - do not swallow
Children under 12 years of age: consult a dentist or doctor
moa: Fluoride from stannous fluoride is incorporated into tooth enamel as fluorapatite, increasing resistance to acid demineralization and promoting remineralization, which prevents caries. The stannous (tin) ion has antibacterial activity against plaque organisms, reducing plaque-associated gingivitis, and occludes exposed dentinal tubules to reduce tooth hypersensitivity.

absolute: Hypersensitivity to stannous fluoride or formulation components

preg: Topical/dental agent with minimal systemic absorption when used as directed (spit out, do not swallow). Not applicable for systemic dosing; systemic risk is low with proper oral use.
lact: Minimal systemic absorption from proper dental use (spit out, do not swallow); systemic exposure to a breastfed infant is expected to be negligible.
renal: Not applicable - dental agent with minimal systemic absorption; no dose adjustment.
hepatic: Not applicable - dental agent with minimal systemic absorption; no dose adjustment.

minor: Calcium/abrasive dentifrices may reduce fluoride availability if used together
interactions.food: Avoid eating or drinking briefly after brushing to prolong fluoride contact; do not swallow product.
interactions.diagnostics: None significant with proper dental use.

serious: Severe or persistent oral irritation requiring discontinuation
emergency: Severe allergic reaction (swelling, hives, difficulty breathing)
Significant accidental ingestion beyond brushing amount - contact Poison Control

monitoring: Oral tolerance: discontinue use if irritation occurs
Tooth sensitivity response - stop use and ask a dentist if pain/sensitivity persists after 4 weeks
Gingival health - ask a dentist if gingivitis, bleeding or redness persists more than 2 weeks, or signs of periodontitis (swollen gums, pus, loose teeth, increasing spaces)
counsel: Apply at least a 1-inch strip to a soft toothbrush and brush all teeth thoroughly for at least 1 minute, twice daily
Do not use more than 3 times a day; minimize swallowing and spit out after brushing - do not swallow
Brush all sensitive areas of the teeth; sensitive teeth may indicate a serious problem needing a dentist
Stop use and ask a dentist if the problem persists or worsens, sensitivity persists after 4 weeks, or gingivitis/bleeding/redness persists more than 2 weeks
Keep out of reach of children under 12; if more than used for brushing is swallowed, contact a Poison Control Center (1-800-222-1222) right away
pk: Anticaries/plaque benefit with regular twice-daily use; sensitivity relief builds over time
Maximum sensitivity protection builds over ~4 weeks of regular use
Minimal systemic absorption; topical/local dental action
Store at controlled room temperature; keep tightly closed
pearls: Topical/dental agent with minimal systemic absorption when spit out - most systemic dosing/safety fields are not applicable
OTC strengths: 0.454% w/w dentifrice (~0.15% w/v fluoride ion) and 0.4% gel
Stannous (tin) ion adds antibacterial/antigingivitis and antihypersensitivity benefits beyond fluoride alone
May cause reversible extrinsic tooth staining - mention at counseling
Sensitivity persisting >4 weeks, or gum bleeding/redness >2 weeks, warrants dental evaluation (possible periodontitis)
missed: Not applicable in a strict dosing sense - resume the regular twice-daily brushing schedule at the next brushing. Do not use more than 3 times a day to make up for a missed brushing.
overdose: When used for brushing, systemic exposure is minimal. If more than the amount used for brushing is accidentally swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center (1-800-222-1222) right away. Acute fluoride ingestion can cause GI upset; manage with supportive care and calcium-containing products as advised.
